name: Visitor's Visa (V1)

requirements.blocker_text: Visit is for holiday, sightseeing, social/recreational, or other short-term purpose other than work.
Genuine, acceptable travel document valid not less than 6 months.

outcome.duration_length: single entry: 30 days; multiple entry: 90 days

sources.title: Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration (DGIE), Rwanda -- V1 visitor's visa: USD 50 single entry (30 days) / USD 70 multiple entry (90 days); free for African Union, Commonwealth, and La Francophonie member-state nationals under visa-waiver arrangements; work prohibited; applicable at border, online, immigration office, or diplomatic mission; status change permitted

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Rwanda). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- fully tier-1 DGIE sourced with concrete fees and durations. Rwanda's visa-waiver arrangement (free entry for AU/Commonwealth/La Francophonie nationals) is a notably broad and distinctive open-entry policy -- effectively covering most of Africa plus a wide swath of Anglophone and Francophone countries worldwide -- worth flagging as a genuine structural feature rather than a narrow bilateral exemption list.
